description: "Frank Mildmay; Or, The Naval Officer" by Frederick Marryat is a novel written during the early 19th century, likely around the 1830s. The story presents the life of Frank Mildmay, who embarks on a naval career, revealing his youthful trials and misadventures, which are woven with autobiographical elements reflective of the author's own experiences at sea.
